title: Andrew Gallimore DMT experiments and entities with consistent taxonomies

tellings.quote: and I know you're working with Andrew Gallammore who does, you know, these DMT experiments,

plain: People who take DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, often say they meet beings, and the story here is that these beings seem to fall into the same recognisable types from one person to the next, which would suggest they are more than private hallucination. Michels raises it in 2026 in a conversation with a guest named Donald Hoffman, mentioning in passing that Hoffman is working with a researcher named Andrew Gallimore, who runs these DMT experiments, without going into what they have found.
